#Flashback
#JohorStateElections
#CalculatingVotes

Two days ago, I was tasked to assist the Malaysia Election Commission in the calculation of the grand total votes and determining the winner.

Never did I imagine that, I would need to end up using a ladder to write down every single individual 'saluran' (Channel) grand finale results from every single school at a very super huge banner that is 3 times taller than my height with a width of at least 50 meters long. 

I would say this is the most stressful calculation I've ever made in my life. It's more stressful than taking an university examination. Cos every single digit I wrote down on the banner itself will determine who's the winning candidate from a particular political party.

This is one of the greatest experience which I've encounter in a state election and I will never forget this precious memorable experience in my life. 

At the end of the day, it truly gives me the feeling of the description of every vote counts and your vote shall make a difference on who will be the next ruling government of the day in your state or nation.

Once again, I would like to take this opportunity to congratulate Barisan Nasional on their Johor State Elections 2/3 Majority Winning. 

To our beloved Pakatan Harapan leadership, I would encourage all of you to once again sit down at the drawing block to restrategize the whole entire election machinery campaign before the 15th General Elections in the coming few months. 

Pakatan Harapan needs to be united if they still want to make themselves relevant to the voters. Gone were the days where grassroots are interested on national issues. 

Today, our grassroots are more focus on how they're able to put their next meal for their family members and how the government are able to improve and elevate their lifestyle with a greater spending power.

Most importantly, how are we able to end this endemic together and achieve a strong national economy recovery in the coming months?
